text:
maria: putting together a perf onboarding intake for Spectra-9B (chat model). goal: baseline latency/throughput, batching profile, and ctx-length sweeps across quant configs. posting checklist and run matrix. :spiral_calendar:
aj: thanks — can you paste minimal run commands so infra can schedule? :+1:
maria: sure. primary env: dedicated A100-80GB, container image rwd/infer:prod-2026-02. target concurrency points: 1,4,8,16. batch sizes 1,4,8,16. ctx lengths: 512, 1024, 2048, 4096. quant configs: fp16, int8, int4 (if supported).
dmitri: do we have int4 kernel support for this arch? bench-bot: int4 is experimental on A100; will fall back to int8 where unsupported. :robot_face:
sophie: add cold-start (empty KV) and warm (primed cache) runs please, and include a 90s sustained run for throughput stability. also capture per-token p50/p95 latencies.
maria: yep — adding those. suggested run matrix (short):
```
for ctx in 512 1024 2048 4096; do
  for q in fp16 int8 int4; do
    for bs in 1 4 8 16; do
      ./run_bench --model spectra-9b --ctx $ctx --quant $q --batch $bs --concurrency 1,4,8,16 --duration 90 --warmup 15
    done
  done
done
```
aj: for concurrency we should sweep separately from batch size otherwise runs blow up. maybe pick concurrency = batch size for a few runs and then a concurrency sweep at bs=8.
maria: good call — will schedule: concurrency-sweep at bs=8 with conc 1,2,4,8,16 and separate batch-sweep w/ conc=bs.
dmitri: please tag me when results land; I want kernel selection plots + profiler traces. also include memory footprint (GPU mem and CPU resident).
maria: will upload raw logs + summary csv. expected metrics: tokens/sec, p50/p90/p99 per-token latency, dram/gpu mem, throughput stability, perf regressions vs current baseline (orca-7b-latest).
sophie: add a quality smoke: run 200 prompt completions (mix of chat and long-context QA) through int8/int4 configs and compute Rouge or embedding-similarity regressions to fp16 baseline. quick heuristic: embedding cosine > 0.92 average is acceptable; flag prompts < 0.85.
maria: noted. I'll include eval harness and seed the prompt set from /evals/spectra-onboard/seed-200.json.
bench-bot: scheduled run 3123456789-01 on cluster a100-ded-12, ETA 2h. logs will be at s3://redwood-bench/spectra/3123456789/. :white_check_mark:
aj: reminder — set trace sampling 1% to keep overhead low, but full traces for one int4 run per ctx to inspect kernel fallback.
maria: done. also adding a short smoke for cold-start latency (single request, measure startup).
dmitri: if int4 fails on any ctx, please capture div/NaN tokens and stop that config. we don't want noisy quality results.
maria: yup, adding early stop. will post summary in this thread when done. expected artifacts: raw-ndjson logs, summary.csv, perf-plots.png, kernel-traces.tar.gz, quality-report.json.
sophie: thanks! will review quality-report and flag regressions for product. :eyes:
maria: ping @aj @dmitri when results are up. thanks team.
